tagline.en: NVIDIA's GEN3C — a Cosmos-based world model for camera-controlled video from a single image, with 3D-consistent navigation.
tagline.zh: NVIDIA 的 GEN3C——基于 Cosmos 的世界模型，从单张图像生成相机可控、3D 一致的可导航视频。

en: GEN3C is a world model from NVIDIA that turns an image into video you can navigate with precise camera control. It's built on NVIDIA's Cosmos Predict1 foundation, and its strength is 3D consistency — the generated view stays coherent as the camera moves through the scene.

The pipeline pairs the GEN3C Cosmos-7B checkpoint with MoGe depth estimation. Named camera trajectories, MoGe depth, and RGBD forward warping are handled as native preprocessing that seeds the generation; you can also supply your own pre-rendered 3D-cache tensors if you already have them.
In WorldFoundry, GEN3C runs through the shared native diffusion pipeline: give it a starting image and a camera path, and it renders a camera-controlled clip with the geometry kept consistent.
zh: GEN3C 是 NVIDIA 推出的世界模型，能把一张图像变成可用精确相机控制来导航的视频。它构建于 NVIDIA 的 Cosmos Predict1 基础之上，强项在于 3D 一致性——相机在场景中移动时，生成的视角保持连贯。
该 pipeline 将 GEN3C Cosmos-7B checkpoint 与 MoGe 深度估计搭配。命名相机轨迹、MoGe 深度与 RGBD 前向 warping 作为原生预处理，为生成提供初始条件；若你已有预渲染的 3D-cache 张量，也可直接提供。
在 WorldFoundry 中，GEN3C 通过共享的原生扩散 pipeline 运行：给它一张起始图像和一条相机路径，它便渲染出几何保持一致的、相机可控的片段。

whenToUse.en: Reach for GEN3C when you want to explore a scene from a single image with controlled camera moves and 3D-consistent navigation — for example flying a camera through a still.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想从单张图像出发、以可控相机运动进行 3D 一致的场景导航时——例如让相机穿越一张静态图——GEN3C 很合适。

notFor.en: It's a camera-controlled, image-conditioned world model rather than a general text-to-video generator. Checkpoints (including the MoGe depth model) are downloaded separately.
notFor.zh: 它是相机可控、以图像为条件的世界模型，而非通用文生视频生成器。checkpoint（含 MoGe 深度模型）需单独下载。

en: Camera-controlled video from a single image
